contracts.authorization: Callable only by the bundled local desktop webview; it grants no account, credential, filesystem-write, installation, update, or network authority.
contracts.idempotency: The query is read-only. Repeating one request against the same executable paths yields an equivalent projection; the UI accepts results only for its newest requestId.
contracts.compatibility: Version 1 always returns the fixed five-tool catalog and the declared conservative statuses. New fields or status meanings require a new contract version.

requestId.description: Caller-generated correlation identifier used to reject stale UI results.

outputSchema.description: The complete bounded projection for the five V1 tools.

platform.description: The platform family on which discovery ran.

startedAtEpochMs.description: Local monotonic correlation timestamp expressed as Unix milliseconds for freshness display.

completedAtEpochMs.description: Completion timestamp expressed as Unix milliseconds and never earlier than startedAtEpochMs.

tools.description: Exactly one result for every V1 tool in stable product order.

status.description: Observed installation and executable outcome without inferred configuration health.

version.description: Exact normalized version output when available, otherwise an empty string.

candidateCount.description: Number of distinct executable candidates found after canonical-path deduplication.

locationHint.description: A sanitized source hint such as PATH or common location, never a complete user path or OS username.

compatibility.description: Conservative automatic-configuration eligibility for this release unit.

reasonCode.description: Stable presentation reason with no raw command output or secret-bearing diagnostic text.

observability.correlation: requestId is returned unchanged and shown in advanced local details only.
observability.audit: RU-001 emits no persistent audit record; the current in-memory result is the sole local projection.
observability.metrics: RU-001 sends no telemetry and records no persistent metrics; elapsed time is computed in memory for the current scan only.

errorSemantics: An invalid requestId rejects the whole query before any probe starts.
A missing executable is a successful not_found result rather than a command failure.
A non-zero or empty version command becomes probe_failed for only that tool and raw stdout or stderr is not returned.
A probe exceeding the bounded timeout is killed and becomes probe_timed_out for only that tool.
More than one canonical executable becomes multiple_installations and no candidate is silently selected as compatible.
Any detected version not backed by a verified exact-version allowlist is unverified_read_only.

contracts.authorization: Callable only by the bundled local shell. It grants no network, account, credential, wallet, payment, configuration, updater, telemetry, or server authority.
contracts.idempotency: The query is a deterministic compiled-capability projection. Repeating it in RU-002 returns the same backend_upgrade_required truth except for the caller requestId.
contracts.compatibility: Version 1 has exactly one runtime status, backend_upgrade_required. A later deployed account integration requires a superseding contract and release unit rather than changing this meaning.

outputSchema.description: A fail-closed RU-002 projection that prevents unavailable remote capabilities from appearing live.

status.description: The only truthful account capability state in RU-002.

networkAttempted.description: Whether this projection attempted any account network request.

serverNamespace.description: The future first-party namespace required before activation.

authorization.description: Whether website device authorization is available in this client-only unit.

accountSummary.description: Whether real account balance and summary data is available.

usage.description: Whether real account usage data is available.

pricing.description: Whether a server-authoritative official-versus-actual price projection is available.

recharge.description: Whether a verified first-party recharge destination is available.

comparisonFx.description: Product-approved display context that is not a live rate or billing input.

usdToCny.description: The product-approved fixed USD-to-CNY comparison display rate.

purpose.description: The sole permitted purpose of the fixed rate.

liveRate.description: Whether the fixed display rate is a live market exchange rate.

observability.correlation: requestId exists only in transient local UI state.
observability.audit: RU-002 creates no account or authorization audit record because it performs no remote or persistent account operation.
observability.metrics: RU-002 records and uploads no account, billing, or readiness metric.

errorSemantics: The projection never falls back to browser cookies, browser access tokens, a manually pasted PAT, generic NewAPI token CRUD, or public pricing interpretation.
Unavailable balance, usage, price, model, and wallet data are represented as unavailable rather than zero or stale values.
A future server becoming reachable does not silently activate RU-002; activation requires a superseding frozen contract and executable deployed integration evidence.

contracts.authorization: Callable only by the bundled local desktop webview. It grants no network, credential, configuration-read, configuration-write, rollback, installation, updater, telemetry, account, billing, or production authority.
contracts.idempotency: The query is a pure deterministic projection. The same requestId, toolId, and lineId produce the same preview with no observable side effect.
contracts.compatibility: Version 1 contains the fixed five-tool and two-line preview catalog and always blocks apply. Enabling a model, credential, write, test, or new adapter requires a superseding contract version and frozen release unit.

outputSchema.description: A truthful preview-only projection that cannot mutate the machine.

status.description: The only RU-003 preview capability state.

rootUrl.description: The exact product-approved root URL for the selected line.

protocolEndpoint.description: The documented protocol endpoint preview, or an empty string when withheld.

endpointStatus.description: Whether the endpoint is a documented preview or withheld as unverified.

targetFile.description: Sanitized documented target file hint, or an empty string when withheld.

ownedFields.description: Documented fields a later verified adapter may own; never values read from the machine.

model.description: Truthful model-selection availability for this client-only unit.

status.description: The prerequisite that prevents a real model selection.

modelId.description: Always empty because no server model catalog is available.

apply.description: Fail-closed apply readiness and named prerequisites.

status.description: The only permitted apply state in RU-003.

blockers.description: Every missing prerequisite for safe automatic configuration.

networkAttempted.description: Whether the preview attempted any network request.

configurationRead.description: Whether any existing configuration content was read.

configurationWritten.description: Whether any configuration content was written.

credentialAccessed.description: Whether any credential source was accessed or executed.

observability.correlation: requestId exists only in transient local UI state.
observability.audit: RU-003 writes no configuration receipt or persistent audit record because it performs no operation.
observability.metrics: RU-003 records and uploads no preview, tool, line, model, credential, or configuration metric.

errorSemantics: An invalid requestId, toolId, or lineId rejects the pure projection without any side effect.
DSH returns an empty protocolEndpoint and targetFile with endpointStatus withheld_unverified instead of guessing an adapter contract.
The model remains server_catalog_required and an empty modelId is never rendered as a real model.
Every projection blocks apply and keeps all four side-effect flags false.
No future server availability or newly installed tool silently upgrades this contract into a write-capable flow.

contracts.authorization: Callable only by the bundled local desktop webview after an explicit user action. It may resolve and open TCP port 443 only for the two compiled first-party hosts and grants no HTTP, model, account, credential, configuration, filesystem-write, telemetry, updater, DNS-change, or server-management authority.
contracts.idempotency: The query is read-only and creates no retained record. Repeating it produces a new point-in-time observation; the UI accepts only the newest requestId.
contracts.compatibility: Version 1 always checks exactly two compiled line hosts and returns the closed outcome vocabulary. Adding a host, protocol request, payload, redirect, secret, repair action, or outcome requires a new contract version and accepted decision.

requestId.description: Caller-generated correlation identifier used to reject stale UI results.

outputSchema.description: Point-in-time DNS and TCP-443 evidence for both approved 野菜API line hosts.

startedAtEpochMs.description: Local start timestamp in Unix milliseconds.

completedAtEpochMs.description: Local completion timestamp in Unix milliseconds.

lines.description: Exactly one observation for each approved line in stable product order.

displayName.description: Compiled beginner-readable Chinese line name; localized display is owned by the client.

rootUrl.description: Compiled HTTPS root shown for identification only; no HTTP request is made.

host.description: Compiled first-party hostname used for the bounded resolver and socket operation.

port.description: The only permitted TCP destination port.

status.description: Bounded DNS and TCP outcome with no API-health inference.

latencyMs.description: Elapsed local wall-clock milliseconds for this bounded observation; it is not a model-response speed claim.

reasonCode.description: Stable safe presentation reason that contains no raw resolver or socket error.

observability.correlation: The requestId is returned unchanged and may be shown locally in advanced details.
observability.audit: RU-005 creates no retained diagnostic record and uploads no event.
observability.metrics: Latency and outcome exist only in the current in-memory page state; no metric, hostname result, address, or error text is uploaded or persisted.

errorSemantics: An invalid requestId rejects the whole query before any DNS or TCP operation.
The implementation uses only the two compiled host and port pairs and accepts no caller-provided URL, host, port, path, header, body, credential, proxy, or redirect.
DNS resolution failure, TCP connection failure, and timeout remain distinct safe reason codes; raw resolver and socket errors and resolved addresses are never returned.
A reachable result proves only that a TCP connection to port 443 completed at that moment and must not be presented as proof of TLS, HTTP, API, account, model, price, billing, or inference health.
One line failure does not suppress the other line result, and a stale request completion cannot replace the newest visible result.

contracts.authorization: Bundled local UI, explicit read action only. Three fixed anonymous HTTPS GET paths on the selected compiled first-party origin. No credential, browser session, admin, configuration, server-management, payment, updater or telemetry authority.
contracts.idempotency: No retained state. A refresh has a new requestId; only the newest request for the current line can be consumed. No automatic retry or pricing_version-based cache.
contracts.compatibility: Version 1 projects public model metadata only. Bootstrap contract recognition is deliberately separate from account and tool-write authorization. Existing local-only preview v1 remains pure and unchanged.

outputSchema.description: Sanitized public, point-in-time service catalog with no account authorization

observedAtEpochMs.description: Local completion time, not server freshness guarantee

serviceVersion.description: Public server version or empty when unavailable

backendDisplayExchangeRate.description: Backend display setting only, never the comparison FX

groups.description: Public visible groups; not account entitlements

multiplier.description: Observed positive group multiplier, not a final price

endpoints.description: Declared protocol IDs, not actual test results

billingMode.description: Billing category only, no evaluated price

declaredCapabilities.description: Declared feature names; none is automatically activated

secretsAccessed.description: This unit never reads a credential

observability.correlation: Echo requestId and local observation time; never echo raw errors or URLs from a remote payload.
observability.audit: No persisted audit or upload in this client-only unit.
observability.metrics: No telemetry; outcome and observation time exist only in the current UI state.

errorSemantics: Reject invalid input before networking.
Only static HTTPS origins and fixed paths are permitted; redirects and arbitrary backend URLs are never followed.
Response bodies, item counts and execution time are defensively bounded; unknown metadata is discarded without widening permissions.
Malformed pricing clears groups/models; a valid empty catalog is not an error and is not replaced with samples.
No raw server message, billing expression, secret, personal information or price is returned to the renderer.
Recognized bootstrap cannot produce authenticated, compatible or applied state.
